title: 779. Reaching Points

examples.explanation: A forward chain such as (1,1) -> (1,2) -> (3,2) -> (3,5) reaches the goal.
No sequence of allowed jumps produces (2,2) from (1,1).
Start equals target, so no move is needed.

hints: Work backwards from the target: the larger coordinate must have come from subtracting the smaller one.
When one coordinate already matches the start, check divisibility: the gap on the other axis must be a multiple of the fixed coordinate.
Use remainders instead of single subtractions so huge coordinates shrink in logarithmic steps.
